prompt: On a tar rooftop at night, a 35mm lens held low and to his left, tilted a few degrees. A young soft-featured Italian American of about 24 sings three-quarter on, his face a third of the frame height: round cheeks, small upturned nose, full lips, a dimple in a smooth chin, wide-set eyes, stubble just starting, hat tipped too far back so his whole face shows, collar open. A Thompson is held up on his far side, muzzle to the sky. Behind him a bullet-riddled wooden water tank on iron legs sprays a dozen thin jets, which catch purple neon from the skyline. A pale yellow bulb on the stair-head to the side lights his mouth clearly. Tar glistens wet around his shoes. Thanks.
